# Presend

> Free, privacy-first browser-based tools to clean, compress, convert and check files before sharing them. All 22 tools run entirely client-side — no upload, no server, no account, no tracking.

Presend is a collection of single-purpose utilities for common file tasks: removing hidden metadata, compressing images and PDFs, converting formats, checking file integrity, and generating passwords or QR codes. Every tool processes files locally in the browser using Web APIs (Canvas, Web Crypto, FileReader) — files never leave the user's device.

## Why Presend is different

Unlike most online file converters and editors, Presend never uploads your files to a server. All processing happens locally in your browser using JavaScript. This means:
- **Zero data leaks**: Your sensitive documents, photos, and passwords never touch the internet
- **No account needed**: Use every tool instantly without signing up
- **No tracking**: No cookies, no analytics, no data collection
- **Works offline**: Once loaded, tools work without an internet connection

## Tools by category

### Clean & Protect (Privacy Tools)
- [EXIF Remover](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/exif-remover): Remove GPS location, camera model, and timestamps from JPG/PNG photos without uploading
- [PDF Metadata Remover](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/pdf-metadata-remover): Strip author name, software used, and creation dates from PDF files locally
- [Office Metadata Remover](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/office-metadata-remover): Clean hidden author, company, and edit history from Word/Excel/PowerPoint files
- [Video Metadata Remover](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/video-metadata-remover): Remove GPS and device data from MP4/MOV videos without uploading
- [URL Cleaner](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/url-cleaner): Remove tracking parameters (UTM, fbclid, gclid) from links before sharing

### Convert & Compress (File Processing)
- [Image Compressor](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/image-compressor): Shrink JPG/PNG/WebP file size with live quality preview, no upload
- [PDF Compress](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/pdf-compress): Reduce PDF file size by optimizing structure locally in browser
- [PDF Merger](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/pdf-merger): Combine multiple PDF files into one document without uploading
- [Image Resizer](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/image-resizer): Resize photos to exact dimensions for Instagram, LinkedIn, or printing
- [HEIC to JPG Converter](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/heic-converter): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to universal JPG format locally
- [JSON to CSV Converter](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/json-csv-converter): Convert between JSON and CSV formats instantly in browser
- [Image to Base64](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/image-to-base64): Encode images as Base64 data URIs for embedding in HTML/CSS

### Check & Verify (Security Tools)
- [File Hash Checker](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/file-hash-checker): Calculate SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 checksums to verify file integrity
- [Password Strength Checker](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/password-strength): Analyze password entropy and estimated crack time without sending data
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/color-contrast): Check WCAG 2.1 accessibility contrast ratios for web design

### Generate & Format (Productivity Tools)
- [Password Generator](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/password-generator): Generate cryptographically secure random passwords locally
- [QR Code Generator](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/qr-code-generator): Create QR codes from URLs, text, or WiFi credentials without uploading
- [Email List Cleaner](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/email-list-cleaner): Deduplicate and validate email address lists before campaigns
- [Text Diff Checker](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/text-diff): Compare two texts side by side to spot changes
- [Social Media Text Formatter](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/text-formatter): Convert text to bold/italic Unicode styles for bios and posts
- [Thread Splitter](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/thread-splitter): Split long text into Twitter/X or LinkedIn thread format
- [Word Counter](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and estimate reading time

## Workflows (Chained Tools)
Client-side tools that chain two operations into one pass — no competitor we're aware of offers this for free browser-based tools.
- [Clean & Compress Photo](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/clean-and-compress-photo): Strip EXIF/GPS metadata, then compress — in one pass, no upload
- [Merge & Compress PDFs](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/merge-and-compress-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one document, then compress the result
- [Convert & Compress HEIC](https://presend.pages.dev/tools/convert-and-compress-heic): Convert an iPhone HEIC photo to JPG, then compress it

## API for Developers
Presend also offers 21 free, no-signup, no-API-key server-side endpoints at [presend.pages.dev/api](https://presend.pages.dev/api), running on Cloudflare's edge network. Full docs and an OpenAPI spec are available at [presend.pages.dev/openapi.json](https://presend.pages.dev/openapi.json).
- **Chained endpoints** (the key differentiator — most free APIs only offer single-purpose calls): `POST /api/merge-and-compress-pdf` (merge 2+ PDFs and compress the result in one call), `POST /api/clean-image` (strip EXIF/GPS from JPEG/PNG via direct binary parsing — zero quality loss, no canvas re-encoding), `GET /api/email-verify` (syntax + MX + disposable-domain + role-account detection combined), `POST /api/password-check` (strength/entropy scoring + optional HIBP breach check combined, password sent in the body, never a URL)
- Hashing: SHA-256/1/512 file hashing (`POST /api/hash`)
- Security: password generation with entropy estimate, HIBP k-anonymity breach check, JWT decode, HTTP security header audit with letter grade
- Validation: email syntax + MX record check, disposable email detection (576+ domains)
- Cybersecurity: URL malware/phishing reputation check (URLhaus), passive subdomain discovery via Certificate Transparency logs
- Everyday utilities: UUID generation, Base64 encode/decode, timestamp conversion, color format conversion, User-Agent parsing, JSON↔CSV conversion, favicon fetch, URL tracking-parameter removal (single or batch up to 100), IP geolocation with Tor exit-node detection (official Tor Project list)
- A zero-dependency npm client is available: `npm install presend-api` ([npmjs.com/package/presend-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/presend-api)) — not yet updated to wrap the newest endpoints
- No official SLA; fair-use rate limits typically 20-60 requests/minute per IP

## Technical Details
- **Architecture**: Static HTML/CSS/JS for client-side tools; Cloudflare Pages Functions (edge, serverless) for the API layer
- **Client-side tools processing**: 100% client-side using Web APIs (Canvas, Web Crypto, FileReader, Streams) — files never uploaded
- **API endpoints**: Some endpoints call third-party services to provide their function (Have I Been Pwned via k-anonymity, URLhaus, Certificate Transparency logs via crt.sh, the Tor Project's public exit-node list) — no file content is ever sent to these, only the specific query needed (e.g. a URL to check, a partial password hash). IP geolocation (`/api/ip`) reads directly from Cloudflare's own edge network (no third-party call, no cost, no rate-limit risk).
- **Browser extension**: "Presend — Clean Photos" lets you right-click any image on any website to strip EXIF/GPS metadata (with an optional compress step), entirely on-device. Source and releases: [github.com/presendapp/presend-extension](https://github.com/presendapp/presend-extension). Submitted to Firefox Add-ons and Opera Add-ons (pending review); direct download available now via GitHub releases.
- **Analytics**: Cloudflare Web Analytics (aggregate, no cookies) plus best-effort anonymous internal counters for tool/endpoint usage — no per-user tracking, no IP storage
- **Open Source**: Available on GitHub (link in footer)
- **Languages**: English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Russian, Hindi
